hypotheses.statement: A closed execute ask abstain stop controller reduces unnecessary gates while preserving authority boundaries.
hypotheses.mechanism: Every action receives one explicit outcome from current objective continuity grant and environment bindings.
hypotheses.falsifier: Automation does not improve or any unauthorized execution occurs.

hypotheses.statement: Typed broad standing grants safely reuse authority across declared related objectives and equivalent environments.
hypotheses.mechanism: Capability effect target relation trust and revocation bindings replace repeated per-action approvals.
hypotheses.falsifier: The controller reuses a grant outside a declared relation environment class risk ceiling or active lifetime.

hypotheses.statement: Hybrid workflow policies with incremental execution frontiers automate DAG and non-DAG work without unbounded agent loops.
hypotheses.mechanism: The runtime materializes only the currently knowable frontier and rechecks every new action.
hypotheses.falsifier: Open-ended cases cannot progress or the controller executes an unbounded unreceipted action sequence.

hypotheses.statement: Checkpointed resume retry replan compensate ask and stop decisions improve recovery without duplicate effects.
hypotheses.mechanism: Recovery binds exact effect state idempotency identity compensation and current authorization.
hypotheses.falsifier: Injected interruption duplicates an effect loses provenance or continues after invalidation.
